onLaunch.title: On launch
onLaunch.description: What NoteFerry shows when it opens.
onLaunch.sheetDescription: Choose what NoteFerry shows when it opens.

homeScreenLayout.title: Home screen layout
homeScreenLayout.description: Show one database per row, or two square cards per row.

highContrast.title: High contrast
highContrast.description: Increase the contrast of dividers, borders, and switches.
highContrast.sheetDescription: Choose how much contrast to use for dividers, borders, and switches.

homeScreenOrder.title: Home screen order
homeScreenOrder.description: Drag to reorder the databases shown on the home screen.

proGate.title: Available with NoteFerry Pro
proGate.layoutMessage: Pro unlocks the two-column layout and custom database ordering.
proGate.launchMessage: Pro can launch directly into a selected database.
proGate.orderMessage: Pro lets you set a custom home-screen database order.

language.title: Language
language.description: Choose the language NoteFerry displays in.
language.sheetDescription: Choose a language, or follow your device's setting.

notion.heading: Notion
notion.manageButton: Manage the NoteFerry connection in Notion

dangerZone.heading: Danger zone
dangerZone.description: Permanently deletes your account and everything associated with it. Store subscriptions must be canceled separately.

requestData.successMessage: We'll email you a copy of your account data once it's ready.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete your account?
deleteConfirm.message: This permanently deletes your NoteFerry account, connections, and quick-entry destinations. This can't be undone. Deleting your NoteFerry account does not cancel an App Store or Play Store subscription.

offline.title: Notify when back online
offline.description: Notify you if a page was created while offline.

sales.title: Notify me about subscription sales
sales.descriptionActive: Disabled while NoteFerry Pro is active. Expiration will not turn it back on.
sales.descriptionInactive: Optional marketing notifications for limited-time NoteFerry Pro offers.

quickActionSettings.description: Free includes one database shortcut; Pro includes up to six. Long-press the app icon to use one. Your full saved selection is restored after re-upgrading.

proGate.title: Add more Quick Actions with Pro
proGate.message: Free includes one home-screen database shortcut. Pro includes up to six.

showAll.title: Show all databases from all workspaces
showAll.description: Show every connected workspace's databases together on the home screen, instead of just the current workspace's.

dataSources.title: Data sources
dataSources.subtitle: Choose a Notion data source to enable quick entry.
dataSources.empty: No data sources found. Make sure this workspace has databases shared with the NoteFerry integration.

proUpsell.title: Add unlimited databases with Pro
proUpsell.message: Free includes three active databases. You can replace one from Database settings.

customizeGate.title: Customize databases with Pro
customizeGate.message: Pro unlocks aliases, form settings, templates, and post-creation behavior.

databaseSettings.description: Free includes three active databases. Locked databases and saved Pro configuration are retained; replacing or removing one never changes anything in Notion.

replacePanel.title: Replace an active database
replacePanel.description: Choose the Free slot to replace with {{title}}.

databaseSettings.empty: Your selected databases will appear here.

customizeGate.title: Customize forms with Pro
customizeGate.message: Pro lets you change aliases, visibility, required fields, order, and defaults.
